dispositions.statement: From the 10-K for 2024-12-31 Blue Owl Credit Income tags the rows of its commitments table (about 220 undrawn lines a quarter). That table prints a commitment type, an expiration date, the funded and unfunded commitment and a fair value: no cost, no maturity, no industry and no percent of net assets. Coverage of those four fields falls from 100 to about 69 pct because these rows were added, not because a field was lost on the position rows. The rows are published under the owner's ruling 'keep the undrawn lines'.
